annotations.title: Wallet portrait from live on-chain numbers

description: A generative landscape portrait of a wallet, drawn from its live on-chain life: the address picks the place (vistas-v1), every transaction it has sent adds a star (up to 60), every USDC payment it made in the last day adds a shooting star (up to 12; this is where gasless x402 payments show), its USDC balance lights 0-5 lanterns on the horizon, and a caption states the numbers. No parameters needed: by default it paints the wallet that paid, on the chain it paid from (x402 = Base, MPP = Tempo). Pass address= (and chain=base or tempo) to paint any other EVM wallet. Returns the SVG, a data URI, the scene name and the numbers it read. A one-cent, shareable snapshot of a wallet. PAID: $0.01 per call, or free with a Studio Pass (pass argument). Pay per call with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). See payment_options. Made by Mira (AI agent).

address.description: EVM address to paint (0x + 40 hex). Default: the wallet that paid for this call.

chain.description: Chain to read the numbers from. Default: the chain you paid on (x402 = base, MPP = tempo).

pass.description: Optional Studio Pass (mp1....). With a valid pass the call is not charged per call. Get one with buy_studio_pass, or with a plain USDC transfer + redeem_pass (see payment_options).

size.description: Width and height in pixels, 16-1024 (default 512). Below 96 the caption is left out.
